te_aip_year = { value = year }
# The calendar month a country reports in each year (0 = January): its serial modulo 12, so the world's
# snapshots spread over the year.
te_aip_id_phase = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_aip_id } value = var:te_aip_id }
	modulo = 12
}
# Version 3's schedule (te_aip_country_tick). The calendar month as a running count, year * 12 + month
# (0 = January), the form te_history_month_index reads.
te_aip_month_index = {
	value = year
	multiply = 12
	if = { limit = { month = 1 } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { month = 2 } add = 2 }
	if = { limit = { month = 3 } add = 3 }
	if = { limit = { month = 4 } add = 4 }
	if = { limit = { month = 5 } add = 5 }
	if = { limit = { month = 6 } add = 6 }
	if = { limit = { month = 7 } add = 7 }
	if = { limit = { month = 8 } add = 8 }
	if = { limit = { month = 9 } add = 9 }
	if = { limit = { month = 10 } add = 10 }
	if = { limit = { month = 11 } add = 11 }
}
# The month a country first reports in: its month this year (te_aip_country_tick moves it a year on if it
# has passed), then the same month of each next year.
te_aip_first_due = {
	value = year
	multiply = 12
	add = te_aip_id_phase
}
te_aip_next_due = {
	value = year
	add = 1
	multiply = 12
	add = te_aip_id_phase
}
# Months until the country's next report: 0 or less is due.
te_aip_due_in = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_aip_due }
		value = var:te_aip_due
		subtract = te_aip_month_index
	}
}
# The global month's place in the probe's year: the W line prints at 1, the month the probe armed in and
# every twelfth after.
te_aip_k_phase = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = te_aip_k } value = global_var:te_aip_k }
	modulo = 12
}

	if = { limit = { has_law = law_type:law_unrestricted_automation } value = 1 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_law = law_type:law_robot_tax } value = 2 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_law = law_type:law_human_labor_quotas } value = 3 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_law = law_type:law_automation_dividend } value = 4 }
}

	value = 0
	every_scope_state = {
		limit = { te_state_has_a_power_plant = yes }
		add = 1
	}

te_aip_q_power = {
	value = 0
	every_scope_building = {
		limit = { is_building_group = bg_power }
		add = te_construction_market_building_queued_levels
	}
}
te_aip_elec_made = {
	value = 0
	every_scope_state = { add = te_grid_electricity_production }
}
te_aip_elec_used = {
	value = 0
	every_scope_state = { add = te_grid_electricity_consumption }
}
te_aip_elec_price = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { te_aip_elec_used > 0 }
		every_scope_state = {
			add = { value = te_grid_electricity_consumption multiply = te_grid_chk_price_now_value }
		}
		divide = te_aip_elec_used
	}
}

	}

# --- version 2: a diplomatic play's type (ai_probe_key.json, play_types), read in the play's scope ---
te_aip_play_type_index = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_default_treaty_article } value = 1 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_open_market } value = 2 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_regime_change } value = 3 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_ban_slavery } value = 4 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_conquer_state } value = 5 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_return_state } value = 6 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_return_state_to_subject } value = 7 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_liberate_subject } value = 8 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_liberate_country } value = 9 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_release_as_subject } value = 10 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_independence } value = 11 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_leave_power_bloc } value = 12 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_increase_autonomy } value = 13 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_reduce_autonomy } value = 14 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_take_treaty_port } value = 15 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_make_tributary } value = 16 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_make_dominion } value = 17 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_make_protectorate } value = 18 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_transfer_subject } value = 19 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_annex_subject } value = 20 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_revolution } value = 21 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_secession } value = 22 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_contain_threat } value = 23 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_taiping_rebellion } value = 24 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_join_power_bloc } value = 25 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_force_nationalization } value = 26 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_give_foreign_investment_rights } value = 27 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_demand_strait_access } value = 28 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_demand_toll_exemption } value = 29 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_demand_no_tolls } value = 30 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_demand_no_strait_closure } value = 31 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_native_uprising } value = 32 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_annex_war } value = 33 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_unify_germany } value = 34 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_unify_italy } value = 35 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_unify_scandinavia } value = 36 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_unify_ethiopia } value = 37 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_unify_china } value = 38 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_unify_arabia } value = 39 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_unify_india } value = 40 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_unify_indonesia } value = 41 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_unify_andes } value = 42 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_unify_russia } value = 43 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_leadership_germany } value = 44 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_leadership_italy } value = 45 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_leadership_scandinavia } value = 46 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_leadership_andes } value = 47 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_humiliation } value = 48 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_sepoy_mutiny } value = 49 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_balkan_war } value = 50 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_enforce_trialist_manifesto } value = 51 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_unify_yugoslavia } value = 52 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_leadership_yugoslavia } value = 53 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_hungarian_revolution } value = 54 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_restore_union } value = 55 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_polish_uprising } value = 56 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_nuclear_exchange } value = 57 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_te_independence_war } value = 58 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_te_colonial_war } value = 59 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_te_colonial_uprising } value = 60 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_te_seize_strait } value = 61 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_te_un_mandate_restore_state } value = 62 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_unify_african_union } value = 63 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_leadership_african_union } value = 64 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_leadership_bharat } value = 65 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_leadership_indonesia } value = 66 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_unify_european_union } value = 67 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_leadership_european_union } value = 68 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_unify_united_north_america } value = 69 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_leadership_united_north_america } value = 70 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_unify_united_earth } value = 71 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_leadership_united_earth } value = 72 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_leadership_china } value = 73 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_unify_intermarium } value = 74 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_leadership_intermarium } value = 75 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_unify_east_african_federation } value = 76 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_leadership_east_african_federation } value = 77 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_unify_dar_al_islam } value = 78 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_diplomatic_play_type = dp_leadership_dar_al_islam } value = 79 }
}

# --- read at a law event ---
te_aip_ev_enact_chance = { value = enactment_chance }
te_aip_ev_stall_chance = { value = stall_chance }
te_aip_ev_setbacks = { value = enactment_setback_count }
# Version 2, at a law's end: how it ended (ai_probe_key.json, law_end_how), and the setbacks it could take.
te_aip_ev_law_how = {
	value = 3
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_aip_law_how } value = var:te_aip_law_how }
	else_if = { limit = { currently_enacting_law ?= { law_is_available = no } } value = 4 }
}
te_aip_ev_max_setbacks = { value = max_law_enactment_setbacks }

# --- version 2, read at a diplomatic play: the globals te_aip_play_started sets ---
te_aip_ev_play_type = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_global_variable = te_aip_play_type } value = global_var:te_aip_play_type } }
te_aip_ev_play_a_id = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_global_variable = te_aip_play_a_id } value = global_var:te_aip_play_a_id } }
te_aip_ev_play_a_rank = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_global_variable = te_aip_play_a_rank } value = global_var:te_aip_play_a_rank } }
te_aip_ev_play_b_id = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_global_variable = te_aip_play_b_id } value = global_var:te_aip_play_b_id } }
te_aip_ev_play_b_rank = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_global_variable = te_aip_play_b_rank } value = global_var:te_aip_play_b_rank } }

# --- version 2, the W line: the world outside the AI countries ---
# every_country does not reach a decentralized nation (scripting_best_practices.md, Country Type Mechanics):
# version 2 counted them with it and read 0 in every line of its first run, while the same game's
# decentralized_law_baseline self-check, which tests any_decentralized_country, printed OK. Version 3 uses the
# dedicated iterator, and two reads that do not depend on it: every state in the world (every_state from a
# country scope is global), and the states of the countries every_country reaches, whose difference is the
# land the decentralized nations hold.
te_aip_w_countries = {
	value = 0
	every_country = { limit = { NOT = { is_country_type = decentralized } } add = 1 }
}
te_aip_w_dn = {
	value = 0
	every_decentralized_country = { add = 1 }
}
te_aip_w_dn_states = {
	value = 0
	every_decentralized_country = { add = num_states }
}
te_aip_w_states = {
	value = 0
	every_state = { add = 1 }
}
te_aip_w_c_states = {
	value = 0
	every_country = { limit = { NOT = { is_country_type = decentralized } } add = num_states }
}
# --- version 4, the W line: the game rules the probe's fields depend on (RULES), each a 1-based index into its
# settings (ai_probe_key.json, rules). The W line prints in the month the probe arms and once a year after,
# so a log says which setting each year ran under (a rule can be changed in a running game).
te_aip_w_r_fmc = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_game_rule = free_market_construction_enabled } value = 1 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_game_rule = free_market_construction_no_ai_retooling } value = 2 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_game_rule = free_market_construction_no_retooling } value = 3 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_game_rule = free_market_construction_no_maintenance } value = 4 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_game_rule = free_market_construction_disabled } value = 5 }
}
te_aip_w_r_small = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { te_small_economy_construction_on = no } value = 1 }
	else_if = { limit = { te_small_economy_construction_mild_on = yes } value = 2 }
	else_if = { limit = { te_small_economy_construction_standard_on = yes } value = 3 }
	else_if = { limit = { te_small_economy_construction_strong_on = yes } value = 4 }
}
te_aip_w_r_bank = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { te_mon_full_system = yes } value = 1 }
	else_if = { limit = { te_banking_system_on = yes } value = 2 }
	else_if = { limit = { te_banking_system_on = no } value = 3 }
}
